editions.title: Signal · Sunday 22 November
editions.overview: UBS and the bankers' association push back on Swiss capital rules, an AI sell-off follows supervisors' warnings on AI debt, Anthropic closes a record IPO, the ECB finds ICT gaps at 96 percent of banks as AI attacks spread, and US banks make customers liable for their AI agents.

editions.title: Signal · Friday 20 November
editions.overview: UBS and the Swiss Bankers Association reject key parts of the banking stability package, the ECB finds gaps in cyber and ICT controls at 92 percent of the banks it supervises, and JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard say vendor breaches exposed customer data.

editions.title: Signal · Thursday 19 November
editions.overview: Anthropic prices a record IPO at USD 83 a share, FINMA introduces a 15-day fintech fast track, and Singapore sets AI missions for finance with a sandbox for agent payments.

editions.title: Signal · Wednesday 18 November
editions.overview: UBS is reported ready to accept Switzerland's tougher capital rules, a leak of 15 million Deutsche Bank files shows its oligarch business ran through Zurich and Geneva, and US officials link a wave of outages to rushed patches of AI-found flaws.

editions.title: Signal · Tuesday 17 November
editions.overview: The Fed's Michael Barr warns AI agents could speed bank runs to minutes, Brussels clears UniCredit's takeover of Commerzbank without conditions, and California sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents.

editions.title: Signal · Monday 16 November
editions.overview: A quiet weekend: JPMorgan blocks AI shopping agents from its customers' cards, the FBI warns that the ARTEX AI attack framework is hitting financial firms, and BaFin fines Deutsche Bank over its Postbank migration.

editions.title: Signal · Sunday 15 November
editions.overview: Jensen Huang leaves Nvidia days before its results, Anthropic sets out its IPO as model prices fall, banks count AI use cases while Swiss banks lack scale, ChatGPT and Gemini reach for customers' wallets, and Crédit Agricole bids to reshape Italian banking.

editions.title: Signal · Friday 13 November
editions.overview: Jensen Huang leaves Nvidia with immediate effect, the finance ministry fines former Credit Suisse chair Urs Rohner, and wealth platform FNZ pulls back to its core markets.

editions.title: Signal · Thursday 12 November
editions.overview: McKinsey finds Swiss banks highly profitable but short of AI scale, Nvidia's board weighs Jensen Huang's future, and the SNB sees no credit crunch.

editions.title: Signal · Wednesday 11 November
editions.overview: Anthropic sets the price range for its IPO, global banks put about USD 270 million behind a joint stablecoin, and Avaloq takes its Mosaic platform to the US.

editions.title: Signal · Tuesday 10 November
editions.overview: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at a lower price, Crédit Agricole proposes merging Banco BPM with its Italian arm, and Evident counts a record 111 new AI use cases at banks in the third quarter.

editions.title: Signal · Monday 9 November
editions.overview: Nvidia's board opens an investigation after reports its chief executive was targeted by foreign intelligence, Anthropic's IPO talk falls to about USD 1.2 trillion as OpenAI raises at USD 1.25 trillion, and South Korea moves to scrap bank network separation rules after AI-assisted hacks.

editions.title: Signal · Sunday 8 November
editions.overview: The UBS capital fight turns to a compromise idea, banks put numbers on AI, Binance traces its theft to a tampered AI tool, rates rise as AI stocks fall, and supervisors start inspecting bank AI.

editions.title: Signal · Friday 6 November
editions.overview: An AI-led rout wipes USD 2.5 trillion from US stocks and reaches Asia, Claude starts reading US bank accounts through Plaid, and China blocks SoftBank's purchase of ABB's robotics division.
